notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (Magento-based site, non-Shopify, so Rule 1 products_count inflation risk N/A). Count verification method: the site server-renders an exact '<sup>N</sup> items' item-count element on every category listing page (confirmed reliable across ~20 pages, including correctly showing 0 for genuinely empty categories and >0 for populated ones) - used as primary evidence, cross-checked with catalogsearch site:indiacircus.com queries to surface categories missing from on-site nav (Wall Mirror, Table/Wall Clocks, Planters, Vases). Ownership check: task brief speculated a Nykaa/Pidilite tie; verified independently via web search this is WRONG - India Circus (founded 2013 by Krsnaa Mehta) is a Godrej & Boyce venture (Godrej acquired 51% stake in 2016); multiple live page titles read 'India Circus by Godrej'. No relation to Nykaa found. Duplicate-company check: grepped all existing c*.json in the scratchpad root for company name 'india circus' / brand_site 'indiacircus' / 'nykaa' - no matches, this is the only extraction for this brand in the batch so far. Exclusions applied: Cushion Covers/Bedding/Throws/Curtains/Fabrics/Floor Covering (rugs)/Bath (bathrobes+towels only, confirmed via product-title inspection) = textiles, excluded. Table-runner-mats branch (runners/coasters/napkins/trivets/tablecloths/chopping boards/butter dish) = textile/kitchen-utility roll-up, excluded. Storage & Organisers (69 items, desk organisers/magazine holders/chest of drawers) = functional storage, excluded (Tissue Box Holders carved out separately as a genuine decorative accessory, 27 items). Lunch Boxes = food-storage utility, excluded. Home Fragrances (incl. incense holders) = excluded per scope. Bamboo Showcase (19) and Copper & Steel Showcase (114) are cross-cutting material-based marketing roll-ups that overlap heavily with already-counted Mugs/Trays/Bowls/Jars by product type - dropped per 'never extract collection/roll-up pages' and to avoid double counting. Candle/Candle Holders/Votives parent (11 items) and its 'Candle Votives' sub-page (11 items, same set) are a MIXED roll-up of scented Jar Candles (Home Fragrance, exclude) and Tea-Light Candle Votive Sets (decorative glass holders, include) with titles confirming both product types in the same grid - per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' the mixed parent/sub pages were dropped entirely; only the clean, unmixed 'Tea Light Holders' sub-page (4 items, all wood/metal holders, no scented candles) was kept. Wall Art: two URL structures exist for what is now the same live category (/home-decor/wall-decor/wall-art.html and /wallarts.html, identical title + identical 27-item SSR count) - used once; legacy/alternate sub-paths (root-level wall-art.html=6 items, wallarts/framed-wall-arts.html=5, wall-art/canvas-wall-art-mounted.html=4 vs 26 under two different prefixes, wallarts/wall-art-set.html=21) did not reconcile cleanly to the 27 total (overlapping facets), so only the single authoritative 27-item parent total was kept to avoid double counting. RULE 0 gains: Wall Mirror, Table Clocks, Wall Clocks, Vases and Planters are NOT linked from the live site nav/footer at all (would have been missed by nav-only crawling) - found only via site: search; all five currently server-render '0 items' on their live category listing pages, corroborated by individually checking sample products from web-search results (Bird Land Wall Mirror, Blue Lattice Treasures Wall Mirror, Foliage Play Planter Large) which all show a disabled 'Out Of Stock' button on their PDP - treated as a genuine, verified qty=0 (categories exist and are in-scope per Rule 0/scope, but are currently empty/discontinued), not a null+flag, since the site's own SSR count is unambiguous and corroborated at the product level. Pocket Mirror (accessories/pocket-mirror.html) excluded as a personal fashion accessory (grouped with Watches/Bags/Wallets/Umbrellas in the Accessories nav), not a home mirror. Feature Walls ('Deewar-e-Khaas', 32 items) and Wallpapers for Wall ('NIRVANA') are wall-mural wallpaper products per their own page titles ('Buy Feature Walls Wallpapers for Home Online') - excluded per Home Fragrance/Wallpaper exclusion. Wall Plates (decorative-platters.html / wall-plates.html, both 31 items, same category) checked specifically for mirror products despite nav calling it 'Wall Plates & Mirrors' - none found (no mirror product links or titles anywhere on the page); filed as Decorative Accessories > Wall Plates only.
